title: Detailed crown
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE766'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#FFC11E'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E09A00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='edge' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF3A8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- band -->
  <rect x='14' y='66' width='72' height='20' rx='6' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='14' y='66' width='72' height='6' rx='3' fill='url(#edge)'/>
  <rect x='14' y='82' width='72' height='4' rx='2' fill='#C97F00'/>
  <!-- pearls on band -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='76' r='3.2' fill='#FFFBE0'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='76' r='3.2' fill='#FFFBE0'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='76' r='3.2' fill='#FFFBE0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='76' r='3.2' fill='#FFFBE0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='3.2' fill='#FFFBE0'/>
  <!-- left spike -->
  <polygon points='18,68 26,26 34,68' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <polygon points='22,68 26,26 27.5,68' fill='#FFF3A8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='24' r='5' fill='#FF5A7A'/>
  <circle cx='24.5' cy='22.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFD3DC'/>
  <!-- right spike -->
  <polygon points='66,68 74,26 82,68' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <polygon points='70,68 74,26 75.5,68' fill='#FFF3A8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='24' r='5' fill='#FF5A7A'/>
  <circle cx='72.5' cy='22.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFD3DC'/>
  <!-- centre tall spike -->
  <polygon points='42,68 50,12 58,68' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <polygon points='46,68 50,12 51,68' fill='#FFF3A8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- centre ornament -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='6' fill='#3FD4FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='3' fill='#C8F6FF'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='16.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- half spikes between -->
  <polygon points='30,68 38,38 46,68' fill='#F5B324'/>
  <polygon points='54,68 62,38 70,68' fill='#F5B324'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='36' r='3.4' fill='#9B5BFF'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='36' r='3.4' fill='#9B5BFF'/>
  <!-- jewelled band centre -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='5.5' fill='#3FD4FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='2.6' fill='#E6FAFF'/>
  <!-- side jewels -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='72' r='2.6' fill='#FF5A7A'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='72' r='2.6' fill='#FF5A7A'/>
</svg>
